title: Qt: Use common interface code in the capture options dialog
description:
Add functionality that is present in the capture options dialog
interface list to InterfaceTreeCacheModel and InterfaceSortFilterModel,
and use them in the capture options dialog instead of a QTreeWidget.

This means that the interface lists in the main window, manage
interfaces dialog, and capture options dialog all use common code.

Assisted-by: Claude Sonnet 5

notes.body: This is in advance of adding bookmark management to the capture options dialog.
enabled automatic add to merge train when checks pass
